verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships first-party AI tooling for this story. Its official MCP server explicitly lets AI coding assistants "generate infrastructure code" (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Claude Desktop). Neo accepts plain-English requests such as "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ," and Agent Skills teach assistants Pulumi workflows. missing for 10: detailed docs on Neo's natural-language-to-code output, any code-generation feature inside the CLI itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of generated code quality.
